# `dry printer`

Query Dry's hosted printer capability graph

## Help

```text
Query Dry's hosted printer capability graph

Usage: dry printer [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  search   Search printers by identity, firmware, motion, material, hardware, and macro capabilities
  inspect  Inspect the versioned capabilities and artifacts for one printer
  resolve  Resolve, hash-verify, and download one runtime dry-profile-v1 artifact
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --source <SOURCE>  Registry origin. Can also point at a local or private compatible registry [default: https://api.dry.yemelianov.dev]
  -h, --help             Print help
```
